name: Teriyaki Chicken with Rice
steps: Rinse the white rice until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with 600 ml water, bring to the boil, then cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat until serving.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, ginger and garlic together in a jug until the sugar dissolves. Pour 2 tablespoons into a small bowl and set aside for drizzling.
Trim the chicken thigh fillets and flatten any thick spots so they cook evenly. Pat dry and season with pepper.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for about 4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
Pour the remaining sauce into the pan and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, turning the chicken and spooning the sauce over it, until it thickens to a glossy glaze that coats the chicken.
While the chicken glazes, cut the broccoli into florets and steam for 3 to 4 minutes until bright green and just tender.
Rest the chicken on a board for 2 minutes, then slice into 2 cm strips.
Fluff the rice into bowls, top with the sliced chicken and broccoli, drizzle over the reserved sauce and scatter with the spring onions and sesame seeds.
